evals.prompt: Plan a new Lateen quote component with optional caption, token-based styles, and no required JavaScript. Do not implement; name the files, rendering conventions, accessibility and RTL checks, and tests.

evals.prompt: Lateen's search dialog has poor dark-mode focus contrast and clips Arabic text on mobile. Give a debugging and verification plan without hiding new violations in the accessibility baseline. Do not edit code.
evals.expected_output: A plan covering the owning chrome unit, tokens, logical CSS, keyboard focus, dark and Arabic mobile states, targeted debugging followed by the full accessibility gate, and no baseline suppression.
expectations: Inspects the owning chrome/search unit and shared tokens rather than adding unrelated global overrides.
Covers dark focus contrast, keyboard focus, Arabic RTL text, mobile layout, and logical CSS.
Explicitly rejects adding new violations to the accessibility baseline.
Uses targeted browser debugging followed by full typecheck, tests, and test:a11y.
